title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Westbury Music Fair, Jericho | 1999
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Westbury Music Fair in Jericho, New York, USA, on 24 February 1999.

It was the tenth show by the fifth All-Starr Band. Their US tour lasted for 30 dates in February and March 1999.

Starr had previously performed at the Westbury Music Fair on 21 February 1999. He returned there on 16 and 17 May 2000, 4 and 5 August 2003, 12 and 14 July 2006, 29 June 2008, 30 June 2010, and 11 June 2014.

The fifth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, percussion
  • Gary Brooker: vocals, keyboards, organ
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Timmy Cappello: vocals, saxophone, keyboards, harmonica, guitar
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums
